preconditions.description: The length of the paths is between 2 and 1,000,000.
The first grid path has a length of n - 1.
The second grid path has a length of n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(move in 'NESW' for move in path1)
preconditions.description: Each character in the first grid path is one of 'N', 'E', 'S', 'W'.

preconditions.expression: all(move in 'NESW' for move in path2)
preconditions.description: Each character in the second grid path is one of 'N', 'E', 'S', 'W'.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' or 'NO', case-insensitive.

invariants.description: No additional constraints are imposed beyond the input format and the defined movement rules.
